name: Eric Sorensen
stance: Wants the House to stay in session to pass bipartisan AI safeguards for risk mitigation.

statements.text: A.I. can be an incredible tool, but it must have robust safeguards to ensure responsible development and risk mitigation. I'm calling on @SpeakerJohnson: keep the House in session until we can pass meaningful, bipartisan A.I. reforms to keep people safe before it's too late.
